The '''Eclorar sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] established an outpost in the Eclorar sector.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Eclorar sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
